Maya Chen: Heads-up  International candidate (DevRel role) Ariela K. flight delayed into the evening. Was scheduled for Tue Aug 3 onsite, landing 08:50. New ETA shows 22:40. We need options: overnight hotel + next-day reschedule or move to virtual loop.
Owen Li: Yikes. Which visa status? Any need for interpreter?
Maya Chen: Ariela is eligible to work, US-based but traveling from abroad; requested Spanish interpreter for some parts of the loop. Also requested kosher meals.
Priya Shah: If they're arriving that late, better to book hotel + shift interviews to Wed. Candidate said they prefer in-person if possible.
Travel Desk: We can book one-night hotel (near office) and airport pickup. Do we need car service or taxi voucher?
Maya Chen: Car service preferred due to late hour. Please also arrange a quiet morning slot (prefers 10:30-13:30) and interpreter for the hiring manager chat at 11:30.
Facilities: We can reserve Quiet Suite D for 10:30-13:30 and label kosher lunch. Need headcount for catering?
Maya Chen: Lunch only for candidate + hiring manager = 2. Kosher boxed lunch please.
Owen Li: I can move my panel to 11:00 if that helps. Priya remote at 12:30. Need at least two in-person interviewers; I'll be onsite.
Priya Shah: I'll join remotely, will prep simultaneous interpretation notes and leave async feedback. I'll add interpreter in calendar.
Interpreter Bot: Certified Spanish interpreter assigned: Lucia M. Will join remote and be present for 11:30-12:00 slot.
Travel Desk: Hotel booked: Harborview Inn, confirmation HV-3321. Car booked for 22:50 pickup. Travel stipend pre-auth created: HR-INTL-2026-441.
Facilities: Mac loaner ready at Concierge, badge printed for 08:45 pickup next morning. AV test scheduled 09:45.
Maya Chen: Thanks. I'll send candidate confirmation with hotel + pickup details and new schedule. Also note dietary: kosher only, no dairy with meat.
PeopleOps Bot: Calendar updated: new onsite loop Wed Aug 4 10:30-13:30. Invite sent to participants and interpreter.
Owen Li: Can someone add a short host checklist to the invite (e.g., badge, kosher label, interpreter join link)?
Maya Chen: Adding checklist now. Thanks all. If flight changes again I'll update here. :pray:
